products.name: Multi-Modal Clinical Synthetic Data (Structured + Clinical Notes + Vitals Time-Series) — Commercial
products.short_description: Extend synthetic generation to multi-modal clinical data — structured records plus realistic clinical notes and vitals/time-series, consistent per synthetic patient — so AI teams test document-, signal-, and sequence-based models. products.description:
Go beyond tables: synthetic notes, vitals, and time-series

Real clinical AI runs on more than tables — it consumes clinical notes, vitals, and time-series. This solution extends synthetic generation to multi-modal clinical data: structured records plus realistic clinical notes (NLP-ready) and vitals/time-series, kept consistent across modalities for a single synthetic patient — so AI teams can test document-, signal-, and sequence-based models, not just tabular ones.

Run it yourself — simpler, cheaper, and proven

You do not need a consultant. The package hands you the field-tested method as self-guided, click-by-click documentation a competent admin can follow end to end — backed by ready-to-run Python tooling.

  • Simpler — exact, ordered steps with full navigation paths; every object you create is named and reused through testing and troubleshooting.
  • Cheaper — one fixed price instead of an open meter; a comparable consulting engagement runs well into the thousands per day. Reusable on every rollout.
  • Tested — a pilot-first method (Assess → Configure → Pilot → Validate → Expand) with explicit pass/fail gates.

What's inside

  • Solution Overview — the multi-modal model: structured + notes + vitals/time-series, cross-modal consistency for a synthetic patient, and privacy posture.
  • Requirements Guide — each prerequisite with how to verify/implement (base structured harness, note/vitals references, environment, governance).
  • Implementation Guide — extend generation to clinical notes (NLP-ready) and vitals/time-series, enforce cross-modal consistency, validate realism, and expand, pilot-first.
  • 5 Python tools — assessment/profiling, generation or scenario execution, a fidelity/coverage report, a privacy/validation check, and a scope/config helper — authentic to synthetic-data engineering (safe by default; no real PHI written to shared locations).
  • Testing/validation gates (modalities generated, consistent, realistic) plus Best Practices for multi-modal fidelity.

The repeatable way

Every solution follows the same repeatable shape, so each deployment feels familiar and low-risk — buy once, reuse the playbook for the next wave and the next project.

The bottom line

Synthetic clinical data across modalities — structured, notes, and vitals/time-series, consistent per patient — so AI teams test the models real care actually uses.

What you receive — every file in your download

This package is delivered as downloadable files you keep and reuse across unlimited devices — nothing is left out and nothing else is required:

  • Implementation Guide (PDF) — the complete, click-by-click solution: solution overview, requirements, step-by-step implementation, testing & validation, troubleshooting, best practices.
  • Automation Scripts (ZIP) — 5 ready-to-run scripts (read-only discovery/validation/reporting; remediation defaults to a safe preview):
    • crossmodal_consistency_check.py — verify the modalities tell the SAME story, and scan for real PHI
    • fidelity_coverage_report.py — measure modality coverage and fidelity of a multi-modal synthetic set
    • modality_scope_assess.py — profile which modalities each AI/QA use case needs (structured/notes/vitals)
    • multimodal_generate.py — generate structured + notes + vitals for synthetic patients from ONE state
    • scope_config_helper.py — initialize and validate the single Multi-Modal Config that drives everything

Delivered as a Word document and PDF, plus all Python scripts and tools in a single ZIP — yours to keep and reuse.
